tei:div.tei:p: Emma Lazarus’s translation, “In the Night” — derived from the piyyut נַפְשִׁי אִוִּיתִיךָ בַּלַּיְלָה by Moses ibn Ezra — was first published in her anthology, Songs of a Semite: The dance to death and other poems (1882), pages 78-80. Many thanks to Shoshana Michael Zucker for identifying the original piyyut from which Emma Lazarus made her translation. This is the first time we are aware of Emma Lazarus’s rhymed English translation being set side-by-side with ibn Ezra’s Hebrew.
